label: textIgnored: Cut and Copy go dark while a sheet's field has focus and no image is open
pasteNeedsNoImage: Paste turns on with any pasteboard in a window
selectAllUnderSheet: Edit > Select All selects the canvas behind a sheet
find: return isPresenting && ws.canvas != nil ? .unavailable("Finish the open sheet first.") : base

label: commandADropped: Select > All goes dark with no window, so a field loses Command-A
runSkipped: a menu item's run never reaches the catalog
agentTooltips: menu items show the agent call's summary (RGBA bytes, marks saved) as their tooltip
menuSummariesIgnored: menuSummary falls through to the catalog's summary
